name: Terran Wind

frame.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
frame.description: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

perks.name: Countermass
perks.description:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Remote Detonation
perks.description:
Fires a slower grenade projectile that bounces and detonates on trigger release.
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases magazine size

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

flavor: "The Great Machine isn't killing us. We're killing ourselves over the Great Machine." —Brivi, transl. from Eliksni
